calibrated.label: Calibrated
calibrated.note: Fitted to the real drives on two horizons (15 s windows with the real dog replayed, and whole drives re-run in closed loop with the dog policy measured from the collie), at a 0.2 s step. Heading rule: 99.8% copying a neighbour, 0.1% avoiding collisions, <0.1% pull toward neighbours, <0.1% fleeing the dog. Here it re-runs each real drive from its first frame. On these drives: cohesion 1.7 m and alignment 0.98 (real flock 1.13 m, 0.95). Its flight from the dog is tiny, because in real drives the flock is already moving the right way, so the data cannot tell how hard sheep react to the dog. Switch the scenario to back and forth to see it fail to turn the flock at the posts.

calibrated1.label: Calibrated, 1 s step
calibrated1.note: The same two-horizon fit at the published 1 s step. Heading rule: 81.5% copying a neighbour, 15.4% avoiding collisions, 0.4% pull toward neighbours, 0.7% fleeing the dog. On the real drives it keeps the flock aligned (P 0.95) but looser than the real one (cohesion 2.4 m vs 1.13 m).

short.label: Short-horizon fit
short.note: Fitted only on 15 s windows, at a 1 s step. Heading rule: 81.4% copying a neighbour, 17.2% avoiding collisions, 0.5% pull toward neighbours, 0.4% fleeing the dog. Nothing in short windows constrains cohesion, so over whole drives the flock comes apart (cohesion 3.2 m, 16% of sheep more than 5 m from the centre).
